ports.title: Published ports
ports.description: Open a TCP or UDP port on the server's address, for traffic that doesn't go through the proxy.
ports.publishedHint: The port opened on the server.
ports.targetHint: The port the container listens on.

empty.title: Nothing is published
empty.description: Web traffic reaches this service through its domains. Publish a port only for anything else.

deleteDialog.title: Remove this port?
deleteDialog.description: {{port}} will close at the next deploy.

deleteAllDialog.title: Remove all ports?
deleteAllDialog.description: Every published port will close at the next deploy.

ports.protocolHint: TCP for most services, UDP for DNS and game servers.

deploy.title: How it runs
deploy.description: Replicas, updates and the process inside the container.
deploy.replicasStoppedHint: A stopped service can stay at 0, but needs at least 1 to start again.
deploy.zeroDowntimeHint: Start the new task before stopping the old one.
deploy.zeroDowntimeWithPorts: Off while this service publishes ports: a new task can't bind a port the old one still holds.
deploy.tiniInitHint: Adds a small init that reaps zombie processes and forwards signals.
deploy.commandHint: Replaces the image's command. It runs directly, unless it uses shell syntax such as $VAR, | or &&: then it needs /bin/sh in the image.
deploy.stopSignalHint: What a task is asked to stop with.
deploy.stopGraceSecondsHint: How long a task gets to finish before it is killed.
deploy.capAddHint: Linux capabilities to add. Only an administrator can.
deploy.adminOnly: Only an administrator can set these.

errors.replicasStopped: Use a whole number from 0 to 100.
errors.command: Enter a command, or leave this empty.
errors.capabilities: Use known capability names such as NET_ADMIN, each listed once and never in both fields.
errors.sysctls: Use namespaced key=value pairs such as net.core.somaxconn=1024.
errors.stopGraceSeconds: Use a whole number of seconds, from 0 to 3600.
